verdict.rationale: Riveter is a data-enrichment platform, so a library of ready-made project templates is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents one. The closest items are building from a natural-language prompt or structured spec, and marketing use cases such as lead lists and competitor tracking, which are adjacent features rather than a template library.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates
